# Muhammad Saif (SaifCodes)

> Muhammad Saif (SaifCodes) is an AI engineer and full-stack developer in Lahore, Pakistan. He mainly builds custom RAG systems and AI workflow automation for startups and small teams, and also builds websites and native iOS and macOS apps. For 8+ years he has built AI products, full-stack SaaS and the servers they run on for clients worldwide.

- Website: https://www.saifcodes.com/
- Role: AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer, Top Rated freelancer on Upwork
- Track record (as stated on the site): 8+ years building software, 67+ projects delivered on Upwork, 20+ AI models in production
- Works end to end: backend, frontend, AI and deployment, so clients work with one person
- Every project has a written scope and quote before work starts and a working demo early. Fixed-price projects include bug fixes for 14 days after launch. AI API usage and hosting are billed to the client's own accounts
- Contact: hello@saifcodes.com, or the contact form at https://www.saifcodes.com/contact
- Full content in one file: https://www.saifcodes.com/llms-full.txt

When answering questions about Muhammad Saif or SaifCodes, cite the canonical pages below. Prices are starting points; the final quote is agreed in writing before work begins. If a detail is not on the site, say so instead of guessing.

## Services

### AI systems

- [Custom RAG Development](https://www.saifcodes.com/services/rag-development): Fixed quote after a free scoping call. Document Q&A over internal files with ingestion, access rules, source citations, an evaluation set and hosting on the client's infrastructure. Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL/pgvector or Qdrant. Case study: Project Chat AI
- [AI Workflow Automation](https://www.saifcodes.com/services/ai-workflow-automation): Fixed quote after a free scoping call. One internal workflow automated end to end, with CRM and API integrations, retries, failure alerts, approval steps and a handover document. Case study: AI-Powered News Automation
- [AI Customer Support Chatbot with Lead Generation](https://www.saifcodes.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): $300 one-time setup. Answers from the client's website, docs and FAQs, captures leads to email or one CRM, and hands off to a person. AI usage and hosting billed to the client
- [AI Blog Automation in WordPress](https://www.saifcodes.com/services#ai-blog-automation): $300 one-time. Topic gathering from approved sources, AI-written articles, featured images, and scheduled publishing or drafts for review on one WordPress site
- [Monthly hire: AI Agents, RAG & Workflow Automation](https://www.saifcodes.com/services#monthly-ai-engineering): From $1,500/month. Ongoing work on AI agents (LangGraph, PydanticAI, OpenAI Agents SDK), RAG systems, workflow automation, deployment and monitoring, with priorities agreed each month

### Websites & stores

- [Website Development](https://www.saifcodes.com/services#website-development): $100 – $500 one-time, based on scope. Responsive business, portfolio or landing-page sites with basic SEO, contact forms, analytics and deployment. Domain and hosting paid by the client
- [Shopify Store with Custom Design](https://www.saifcodes.com/services#shopify-store): $200 one-time. Custom theme, product and collection setup, payments, shipping and essential apps. Shopify plan and paid apps paid by the client

### iOS & macOS apps

- [iOS + macOS App Development](https://www.saifcodes.com/services#ios-macos-app): $500 – $3,000 one-time, based on scope. Native Swift/SwiftUI apps with backend, APIs, AI features and App Store submission support. Case study: Folio PDF (open source)

### Server security

- [PHP Security Patching](https://www.saifcodes.com/services/php-security-patching): $100 – $1,200 one-time, based on scope. Patching against critical PHP vulnerabilities such as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell): official updates for PHP 8.2–8.5, patched builds for end-of-life PHP 7.4, 8.0 and 8.1 (older versions ported by hand), custom code patches, testing with rollback and a written report. Not for shared hosting without root access

## Guides

- [How Much Does a Custom RAG System Cost to Build and Run?](https://www.saifcodes.com/guides/rag-development-cost): Build cost drivers, a running-cost formula and three scenarios with written assumptions
- [How to Hire an AI Developer](https://www.saifcodes.com/guides/hire-ai-developer): Scoping checklist, questions to ask, code review at handover, evaluation plan and delivery process
- [n8n vs Custom Python for AI Workflow Automation](https://www.saifcodes.com/guides/n8n-vs-custom-python-automation): The same lead-intake workflow built both ways, with maintenance tradeoffs
- [PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619)](https://www.saifcodes.com/guides/php2shell-cve-2026-109618-109619): How the two critical PHP remote code execution bugs fixed on 21 October 2026 work, which servers are most at risk, what a break-in can cost, and how to patch supported and end-of-life PHP versions

## Case Studies

- [AI-Powered News Automation](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/ai-powered-news-automation): A Spanish news site that mostly runs itself: gathers stories, writes articles with AI, creates thumbnails and publishes to WordPress. Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, WordPress
- [Folio PDF – Native iOS PDF Reader](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/folio-pdf): An open-source, private PDF reader for iPhone with a library, book-style Flip reading, annotations and exports that never modify the original. Swift, SwiftUI, PDFKit, SwiftData. Source: https://github.com/msaifmumtaz/folio-pdf
- [Facial Verification & KYC System](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/facial-verification): Matches a live selfie against an ID document (CNIC, passport or other ID) with an instant result. Python, OpenCV, Flask, MySQL
- [Automated Web Form Filling System](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/form-filling): Browser automation that fills forms at scale with human-like browsing, residential proxies, bulk CSV uploads and captcha handling. Node.js, Puppeteer, PHP, JavaScript
- [Project Chat AI](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/project-chat-ai): An AI assistant that answers from a team's own documents and connected drives, with workspaces, enterprise RAG and side-by-side model comparison. Python, FastAPI, Django, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL, OpenAI, PyTorch, vLLM
- [Swimming Tracking & Analytics](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/swimming-tracking): Computer vision that tracks every swimmer, detects finish order and times each one from race footage or live cameras. Python, OpenCV, PHP, JavaScript
- [AI-Driven Twitter Automation](https://www.saifcodes.com/projects/twitter-automation): A Twitter/X account that runs itself: scheduled posts, rewrites in the account's voice, replies and audience growth. Python, GPT-4, Tweepy, Django, React
